page.title: Your tenders
page.subtitle: Read, route and prepare a tender: upcoming deadlines, requirements still without a validated answer, and decisions to make — dossier by dossier.
page.askLauraQuestion: Help me prioritise my ongoing tenders.

intake.title: Import a tender
intake.titlePlaceholder: Dossier name (the one you'll find it under)
intake.textPlaceholder: Paste the consultation text, or drop the file below.
intake.formats: PDF, Word, Excel or text. Extraction happens server-side.
intake.fileTooLarge: This file is {{size}} MB. The limit is {{max}} MB — upload a lighter document, or paste the mission text in the field above.
intake.cost: Analysing and drafting a tender depends on no quota.

preview.title: Import preview
preview.subtitle: What "{{title}}" would create — nothing is written yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.redeposit: Documents to re-upload to archive the source files: the preview is restored as it was, files are not kept before confirmation.

duplicate.warningHash: A dossier with identical content already exists in this workspace: "{{title}}".

failedDocuments.title: Documents not analysed
failedDocuments.hint: Exclude this document or re-run the analysis to resume without losing the rest.

decision.title: Recommendation
decision.questions: To ask the client before answering
decision.markSubmittedFailed: Switching to "submitted" did not go through.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.ready: All mandatory requirements are validated and sourced: the dossier can go out.
compliance.notReady: The dossier cannot go out as it stands — a mandatory requirement without a validated answer, or an unresolved ambiguity, is paid for when the bids are opened.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.empty: No requirement extracted from this document.
requirements.ownerUpdateFailed: The role change did not go through.
requirements.evidencePlaceholder: Paste the excerpt that proves the answer — never generic marketing copy.
requirements.evidenceUpdateFailed: Saving the evidence did not go through.

answerStatus.updateFailed: The status change did not go through.

need.title: Turn into a need
need.subtitle: The RFP joins the open-needs view and becomes material for talent-pool matching. Skills are NOT derived from the document — RFP wording is prose, and turning it into a technology list would rank profiles on words we made up. You enter them on the need.
need.projectPlaceholder: Pick the project to attach it to
need.failed: The need could not be created
need.noProject: No project in your pipe yet. A project comes from an account analysis or a detected signal — it is not created by hand.
need.linked: This tender is already linked to a need.

mask.hiddenNotice: This section is hidden for your workspace.

fromNeed.label: Source need
fromNeed.placeholder: Pick the need this tender starts from
fromNeed.none: No open need in your workspace

sourceDocuments.title: Source documents
